new.brief: Create a special-purpose sorter that applies the sorting of `sorter` to the levels of a `GtkTreeListModel`.
new.md:
Create a special-purpose sorter that applies the sorting
of `sorter` to the levels of a `GtkTreeListModel`.

Note that this sorter relies on [`TreeListModel:passthrough`](xref:gtk:Gtk.TreeListModel#property:passthrough)
being `FALSE` as it can only sort [`TreeListRow`](xref:gtk:Gtk.TreeListRow)s.

doc.brief: Applies a gives sorter to the levels in a tree.

set_sorter.brief: Sets the sorter to use for items with the same parent.
set_sorter.md:
Sets the sorter to use for items with the same parent.

This sorter will be passed the [`TreeListRow:item`](xref:gtk:Gtk.TreeListRow#property:item) of
the tree list rows passed to `self`.
